- It learned from examples, not from hand-written rules
- Two ingredients: a big dataset (ImageNet, 1.2M images) and GPUs
- Error nearly halved in one year; every year after followed the recipe

::: {.footnote}
Data: ILSVRC top-5 error, 2010-2015 (Russakovsky et al., 2015). Chart: own work.
:::

## One formula for the whole course

$$\pi(a \mid o,\; l)$$

::: {.formula-legend}
- $o$ = what it sees
- $l$ = what you told it
- $a$ = what it does
:::
